# Amazon

> > Amazon is a global e-commerce platform offering retail products, digital services, Prime membership benefits, payment solutions, and grocery delivery through Whole Foods Market.

Amazon.com serves as the central hub for online shopping, account management, and membership services. The platform integrates various payment products (Amazon Visa, Store Card, Secured Card), seller programs, and services including Amazon Prime, Amazon Devices, Amazon Business, and Whole Foods Market grocery delivery.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Prime
- Amazon Visa
- Amazon Store Card
- Amazon Secured Card
- Amazon Business Card
- Whole Foods Market
- Amazon Devices
- Amazon Family
- Amazon Hub
- 1-Click settings
- Prime membership benefits
- Seller programs
- Account management
- Payment methods
- Order tracking

## Core Shopping & Homepage

- [Amazon.com. Spend less. Smile more.](https://www.amazon.com/): Amazon main homepage featuring luxury jewelry brands and Prime benefits
- [Amazon.com: Homepage](https://www.amazon.com/stores/Homepage/page/1C97BE5A-7354-49E3-828D-1A49B8513E5E): Main homepage with Prime, Visa, Store Card, and seller program links
- [Amazon.com: Home](https://www.amazon.com/stores/Home/page/C11117E2-47BF-49F6-A82F-5668EB971777): Home category page with furniture, essentials, and Amazon payment products
- [USA Store](https://www.amazon.com/stores/USA/node/17376892011): USA store featuring bestsellers, eGift Cards, and TurboTax products

## Account Management & Settings

- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/homepage.html): Account dashboard for managing Prime, orders, payments, and 1-Click settings

## Prime Membership

- [Amazon.com: Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.com/amazonprime): Prime membership page with benefits, pricing, and student discounts

## Grocery & Food

- [Whole Foods Market: Shop Groceries & Weekly Sales](https://wfm.amazon.com/): Whole Foods Market homepage with organic groceries and Prime member deals

## Product Categories

- [Books](https://www.amazon.com/s?rh=n:2235625011): Books category search results page featuring bestsellers and new releases
